new.s: India's flexible inflation-targeting framework, adopted in 2016, was based on the recommendation of which committee?
new.x: The Urjit Patel Committee (2014) recommended inflation targeting, adopted in 2016 with a 4% CPI-Combined target. The Narasimham Committee dealt with banking reforms, the Malhotra Committee with insurance reforms, and the Raghuram Rajan Committee with financial-sector reforms, not the inflation-targeting framework.

new.s: The Financial Sector Legislative Reforms Commission (FSLRC) was set up and submitted its report in which years respectively?
new.x: FSLRC, chaired by Justice B.N. Srikrishna, was set up in 2011 and reported in 2013. 2010 is the year the FSDC was set up, so 2010 and 2012 is wrong; the other pairs do not match the Commission's timeline.
